title: Mapping stages and discrete targets
scope: Original diagnostic design. No executable patch, product prototype or DAW automation.
procedure: Measure each source alone, both together and both directions around step boundaries.
Record displayed, stored and audible/diagnostic target values separately; never derive a composition equation from the knob graphic alone.
Rename/reorder source controls, replace a target declaration, Undo/Redo and reopen.
acceptance_questions: Reason many-source equation and out-of-interval behavior remain hypotheses until observed.
ADI approved composition/range decisions remain normative even when the reference differs.
Stable IDs survive label/layout changes; target quantization occurs at a specified stage.
evidence: one-step undo and save/reopen result where applicable
authority: Current ADI decisions govern; this is test data, not an implementation.
